## --- model check fit

```{r}
#source("01_fui_two_stage_loo.R", encoding = "UTF-8")

formula01 <- Y ~ HealthCondt2 +
  Race * Gender +
  Race * AgeYR +
  HEI * Race
```


## --joint model result---

```{r}
fit_m1_interaction_01 <- fit_flfoqr_fui_bounded_gamma_betaf_xcov(
  Y = Y_use,
  W = W_use,
  Z = Z_use,

  Nsim = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  tau0 = 0.1,

  ## BMI outcome model
  numeric_Z = c("AgeYR", "HEI"),
  factor_Z = c("Gender", "Race", "HealthCondt2"),
  scalar_formula = formula01,

  ## Measurement model：加入 Age、HEI、Gender
  x_numeric_Z = c("AgeYR", "HEI"),
  x_factor_Z = "Gender",

  ## 协变量解释的 PA 部分 + gamma 进入 outcome
  x_covariate_in_outcome = TRUE,
  x_covariate_prior_sd = 10,

  K_func = 12,
  basis_weights = "unit",
  K_beta = 10,
  beta_bs = "cc",
  periodic_time = FALSE,

  sigma_gamma_prior_mean = 22,
  sigma_gamma_prior_sd = 0.5,
  sigma_gamma_lower = 18,
  sigma_gamma_upper = 22.5,

  a_x_prior_sd = 100,
  sigma_omega_prior_scale = 15,
  sigma_e_prior_scale = 10,

  beta_fixed_prior_mean = 0.0979531,
  beta_fixed_prior_sd = 0.1,
  beta_random_prior_scale = 1,

  chains = 2,
  cores = 2,
  seed = 1123,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 10
)
```

## --Plot
### -----new plot for paper
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

## 1.  beta(t)
beta_raw <- .rfc_beta(
  fit_raw09_loo,
  method = "Raw"
)

beta_fui <- .rfc_beta(
  fit_fui09_loo,
  method = "FUI"
)

fit_joint_plot <- fit_m1_interaction_09

## 2. 

beta_joint <- flfoqr_beta_curve(fit_joint_plot)
beta_joint$method <- "Joint"

## 3. comb
cols <- c("method", "t", "mean", "lower", "upper")

beta_all <- rbind(
  beta_raw[, cols],
  beta_fui[, cols],
  beta_joint[, cols]
)

beta_all$method <- factor(
  beta_all$method,
  levels = c("Raw", "FUI", "Joint")
)


## ============================================================
## 4. Smooth the curves using smooth.spline
## ============================================================

## smaller df = stronger smoothing
## larger df  = closer to original curve
df_val <- 3


smooth_one_curve <- function(dat, df_val) {

  dat <- dat[order(dat$t), ]

  ## posterior mean
  fit_mean <- smooth.spline(
    x = dat$t,
    y = dat$mean,
    df = df_val
  )

  ## lower CI
  fit_lower <- smooth.spline(
    x = dat$t,
    y = dat$lower,
    df = df_val
  )

  ## upper CI
  fit_upper <- smooth.spline(
    x = dat$t,
    y = dat$upper,
    df = df_val
  )

  dat$mean_smooth  <- fit_mean$y
  dat$lower_smooth <- fit_lower$y
  dat$upper_smooth <- fit_upper$y

  dat
}


beta_all_smooth <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    split(beta_all, beta_all$method),
    smooth_one_curve,
    df_val = df_val
  )
)


## Restore factor order
beta_all_smooth$method <- factor(
  beta_all_smooth$method,
  levels = c(
    "Raw",
    "FUI",
    "Joint"
  )
)


## ============================================================
## 5. Plot
## ============================================================

tau_value <- attr(fit_joint_plot, "tau0")


colors <- c(
  "Raw"   = "#A63603",
  "FUI"   = "#08519C",
  "Joint" = "#00BFC4"
)


p_all <- ggplot(
  beta_all_smooth,
  aes(
    x = t,
    y = mean_smooth,
    colour = method,
    linetype = method,
    group = method
  )
) +

  ## Zero reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  ## 95% credible intervals
  ## Show ribbons only for FUI and Joint
  geom_ribbon(
    data = subset(
      beta_all_smooth,
       method == "Joint"
    ),
    aes(
      x = t,
      ymin = lower_smooth,
      ymax = upper_smooth,
      fill = method,
      group = method
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  ## Smoothed mean curves
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 2.0
  ) +

  labs(
    title = bquote(
      tau == .(tau_value)
    ),
    x = "Time of day (hour)",
    y = expression(beta(t)),
    colour = "Method",
    linetype = "Method"
  ) +

  ## Time axis: t is 0--1
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      1,
      by = 4 / 24
    ),
    labels = paste0(
      seq(
        0,
        24,
        by = 4
      ),
      ":00"
    ),
    expand = c(
      0.01,
      0.01
    )
  ) +

  ## Same y-range
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(
      -3,
      2
    )
  ) +

  ## Line colors
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Method",
    breaks = c(
      "Raw",
      "FUI",
      "Joint"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Raw"   = "Naive",
      "FUI"   = "RC",
      "Joint" = "FBQ"
    ),
    values = colors
  ) +

  ## Ribbon colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FUI"   = "#08519C",
      "Joint" = "#00BFC4"
    )
  ) +

  ## Line types
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Method",
    breaks = c(
      "Raw",
      "FUI",
      "Joint"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Raw"   = "FPCA + Naive",
      "FUI"   = "FPCA + MEM",
      "Joint" = "Joint model"
    ),
    values = c(
      "Raw"   = "dotdash",
      "FUI"   = "solid",
      "Joint" = "solid"
    )
  ) +

  ## Suppress ribbon/fill legend
  guides(
  fill = "none",
  linetype = "none"
) +

  ## Background/style
  theme_gray(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey90",
      color = NA
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ),

    panel.grid.minor = element_line(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "white",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),

    axis.line = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "grey20"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),

    legend.position = "bottom",

    legend.direction = "horizontal",

    legend.box = "horizontal",

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.key = element_rect(
      fill = "grey100",
      color = NA
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      5.5,
      5.5,
      5.5,
      5.5
    )
  )


print(p_all)


if (!exists("beta_plot_list", inherits = FALSE)) {
  beta_plot_list <- list()
}
stopifnot(length(tau_value) == 1L, is.finite(tau_value))

# save current tau
beta_plot_list[[as.character(tau_value)]] <- beta_all_smooth
```

### -----comb plot
```{r}


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

tau_order <- c("0.1", "0.5", "0.9")

if (!exists("beta_plot_list", inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop("First save each single-tau beta_all_smooth in beta_plot_list.")
}
missing_tau <- setdiff(tau_order, names(beta_plot_list))
if (length(missing_tau)) {
  stop("Missing plot data for tau: ", paste(missing_tau, collapse = ", "))
}

plot_all_tau <- bind_rows(beta_plot_list[tau_order], .id = "tau")
plot_all_tau$Panel <- factor(
  paste0("tau==", plot_all_tau$tau),
  levels = paste0("tau==", tau_order)
)
plot_all_tau$method <- factor(
  plot_all_tau$method,
  levels = c("Raw", "FUI", "Joint")
)

method_order <- c("Raw", "FUI", "Joint")
method_labels <- c("Raw" = "Naive", "FUI" = "RC", "Joint" = "FBQ")
method_colors <- c("Raw" = "#A63603", "FUI" = "#08519C", "Joint" = "#00BFC4")
method_lines <- c("Raw" = "dotdash", "FUI" = "solid", "Joint" = "solid")

p_three_tau <- ggplot(
  plot_all_tau,
  aes(x = t, y = mean_smooth, colour = method,
      linetype = method, group = method)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  # Keep the panel column in this data so each panel gets its own Joint band.
  geom_ribbon(
    data = subset(plot_all_tau, method == "Joint"),
    aes(x = t, ymin = lower_smooth, ymax = upper_smooth, group = method),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#00BFC4", alpha = 0.18, colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2.0) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Panel, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed",
    labeller = labeller(Panel = label_parsed)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time of day (hour)", y = expression(beta(t)),
    colour = "Method", linetype = "Method"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 4 / 24),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 24, by = 4), ":00"),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  # Same display range as the supplied single-tau plot. Adjust if necessary.
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(-3, 2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Method", breaks = method_order,
    labels = method_labels, values = method_colors
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Method", breaks = method_order,
    labels = method_labels, values = method_lines
  ) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "white", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 12, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "grey100", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

print(p_three_tau)
ggsave(
  "three_tau_comparison.png", plot = p_three_tau,
  width = 11.5, height = 5.2, units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white"
)

```


## --Rescale coefficient of fix effect 

#### -----joint
```{r}
backtransform_scalar_coefs <- function(
    fit,
    Y_use,
    Z_use,
    W_use,
    numeric_Z = c("AgeYR", "HEI"),
    factor_Z  = c("Gender", "Race", "HealthCondt2"),
    reg_formula
) {
  
  library(rstan)
  library(brms)
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 1. Reproduce the exact analysis sample
  ## ============================================================
  
  Z_df <- as.data.frame(Z_use)
  
  for (nm in factor_Z) {
    Z_df[[nm]] <- as.factor(Z_df[[nm]])
  }
  
  idx <- complete.cases(Y_use, Z_df) &
    apply(
      W_use,
      1,
      function(x) all(is.finite(x))
    )
  
  Y0 <- as.numeric(Y_use[idx])
  Z0 <- Z_df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 2. Means / SDs used in standardization
  ## ============================================================
  
  y_mean <- attr(fit, "Y_mean")
  y_sd   <- attr(fit, "Y_sd")
  
  if (is.null(y_mean)) {
    y_mean <- mean(Y0)
  }
  
  if (is.null(y_sd)) {
    y_sd <- sd(Y0)
  }
  
  
  ## continuous covariate means
  z_mean <- sapply(
    Z0[, numeric_Z, drop = FALSE],
    mean
  )
  
  ## continuous covariate SDs
  z_sd <- sapply(
    Z0[, numeric_Z, drop = FALSE],
    sd
  )
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 3. Reconstruct exact scalar design matrix
  ## ============================================================
  
  Z_numeric_scaled <- as.data.frame(
    scale(
      Z0[, numeric_Z, drop = FALSE],
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  Z_factor <- Z0[, factor_Z, drop = FALSE]
  
  Z_final_model <- data.frame(
    Z_numeric_scaled,
    Z_factor
  )
  
  df2 <- data.frame(
    Y = (Y0 - y_mean) / y_sd,
    Z_final_model
  )
  
  
  ## scalar covariates
  z_terms <- setdiff(
    colnames(df2),
    "Y"
  )
  
  
  ## Variables appearing inside interactions
  z_main_no_inter <- setdiff(
    z_terms,
    c(
      "Race",
      "Gender",
      "AgeYR",
      "HEI"
    )
  )
  
  
  ## EXACT same formula as fitted model
  #form_Z <- paste0(
  #  "Y ~ ", 
  #  paste(c(
  #      z_main_no_inter,
  #      "Race * Gender",
  #      "Race * AgeYR",
  #      "HEI * Race"
  #    ),
  #    collapse = " + "
  #  )
  #)
  
  #form_Z <- "Y ~ HealthCondt2 + Race * Gender + Race * AgeYR"
  form_Z <- reg_formula
  
  Dt2 <- brms::make_standata(
    brms::bf(
      as.formula(form_Z),
      quantile = attr(fit, "tau0")
    ),
    data = df2,
    family = brms::asym_laplace()
  )
  
  
  ## Exact names corresponding to b[1], ..., b[p]
  b_names <- colnames(Dt2$X)[-1]
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 4. Extract posterior draws
  ##
  ## IMPORTANT:
  ## a_x       = coefficients of population mean alpha_0(t)
  ## b_func_gq = functional beta mapped into Bx coordinates
  ## ============================================================
  
  post <- rstan::extract(
    fit,
    pars = c(
      "b",
      "b_Intercept",
      "a_x",
      "b_func_gq"
    ),
    permuted = TRUE
  )
  
  
  B_std <- as.matrix(post$b)
  
  stopifnot(
    ncol(B_std) == length(b_names)
  )
  
  colnames(B_std) <- b_names
  
  
  ## Make sure a_x and b_func have same functional dimension
  a_x_draws <- as.matrix(post$a_x)
  b_func_draws <- as.matrix(post$b_func_gq)
  
  stopifnot(
    nrow(a_x_draws) == nrow(B_std),
    nrow(b_func_draws) == nrow(B_std),
    ncol(a_x_draws) == ncol(b_func_draws)
  )
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 5. Restore Y scale for scalar coefficients
  ## ============================================================
  
  B_orig <- B_std * y_sd
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 6. Restore Age / HEI original units
  ##
  ## Age main + Race x Age   : divide by SD(Age)
  ## HEI main + Race x HEI   : divide by SD(HEI)
  ## ============================================================
  
  for (j in seq_along(b_names)) {
    
    pieces <- strsplit(
      b_names[j],
      ":",
      fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]]
    
    
    for (nm in numeric_Z) {
      
      if (nm %in% pieces) {
        
        B_orig[, j] <-
          B_orig[, j] /
          z_sd[nm]
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 7. Correct Race main effects
  ##
  ## Because:
  ##
  ## Age_std = (Age - mean_age) / sd_age
  ## HEI_std = (HEI - mean_hei) / sd_hei
  ##
  ## Race main effects must absorb the centering terms from
  ## Race x Age and Race x HEI.
  ## ============================================================
  
  race_main <- grep(
    "^Race[^:]+$",
    colnames(B_orig),
    value = TRUE
  )
  
  
  find_interaction <- function(
    race_name,
    numeric_name
  ) {
    
    candidates <- c(
      paste0(race_name, ":", numeric_name),
      paste0(numeric_name, ":", race_name)
    )
    
    hit <- intersect(
      candidates,
      colnames(B_orig)
    )
    
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    
    hit[1]
  }
  
  
  for (race_name in race_main) {
    
    ## --------------------------
    ## Race x Age
    ## --------------------------
    
    nm_age <- find_interaction(
      race_name,
      "AgeYR"
    )
    
    if (!is.na(nm_age)) {
      
      B_orig[, race_name] <-
        B_orig[, race_name] -
        B_orig[, nm_age] *
        z_mean["AgeYR"]
    }
    
    
    ## --------------------------
    ## Race x HEI
    ## --------------------------
    
    nm_hei <- find_interaction(
      race_name,
      "HEI"
    )
    
    if (!is.na(nm_hei)) {
      
      B_orig[, race_name] <-
        B_orig[, race_name] -
        B_orig[, nm_hei] *
        z_mean["HEI"]
    }
  }
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 8. FUNCTIONAL POPULATION MEAN alpha_0(t)
  ##
  ## Current fitted outcome model uses:
  ##
  ##   gamma_i' b_func
  ##
  ## but full latent curve is:
  ##
  ##   X_i = a_x + gamma_i
  ##
  ## therefore:
  ##
  ##   gamma_i' b_func
  ##      =
  ##   X_i' b_func - a_x' b_func
  ##
  ## Thus the intercept for the FULL-X representation is:
  ##
  ##   b_Intercept - a_x' b_func
  ##
  ## IMPORTANT: calculate draw-by-draw.
  ## ============================================================
  
  alpha0_func_contrib_std <- rowSums(
    a_x_draws *
      b_func_draws
  )
  
  
  ## b_Intercept corresponds to scalar X before undoing
  ## Age/HEI standardization, but still uses gamma deviation.
  
  intercept_fullX_std <-
    as.numeric(post$b_Intercept) -
    alpha0_func_contrib_std
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 9. Back-transform intercept to original BMI scale
  ## ============================================================
  
  intercept_orig <-
    y_mean +
    y_sd *
    intercept_fullX_std
  
  
  ## Undo Age centering
  if ("AgeYR" %in% colnames(B_orig)) {
    
    intercept_orig <-
      intercept_orig -
      B_orig[, "AgeYR"] *
      z_mean["AgeYR"]
  }
  
  
  ## Undo HEI centering
  if ("HEI" %in% colnames(B_orig)) {
    
    intercept_orig <-
      intercept_orig -
      B_orig[, "HEI"] *
      z_mean["HEI"]
  }
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 10. Final original-scale posterior draws
  ## ============================================================
  
  coef_orig <- cbind(
    Intercept = intercept_orig,
    B_orig
  )
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 11. Posterior summaries
  ## ============================================================
  
  summ <- function(x) {
    
    c(
      Mean = mean(x),
      SD = sd(x),
      
      `2.5%` = unname(
        quantile(
          x,
          0.025
        )
      ),
      
      `50%` = unname(
        quantile(
          x,
          0.50
        )
      ),
      
      `97.5%` = unname(
        quantile(
          x,
          0.975
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  tab <- as.data.frame(
    t(
      apply(
        coef_orig,
        2,
        summ
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 12. b[1] ... b[p] mapping
  ## ============================================================
  
  mapping <- data.frame(
    
    parameter = paste0(
      "b[",
      seq_along(b_names),
      "]"
    ),
    
    term = b_names
  )
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 13. Useful intercept diagnostics
  ## ============================================================
  
  intercept_gamma_std <-
    as.numeric(
      post$b_Intercept
    )
  
  
  intercept_gamma_Yscale <-
    y_mean +
    y_sd *
    intercept_gamma_std
  
  
  alpha0_func_contrib_Yscale <-
    y_sd *
    alpha0_func_contrib_std
  
  
  intercept_diagnostics <- data.frame(
    
    quantity = c(
      "b_Intercept: gamma parameterization, standardized Y",
      "alpha0 functional contribution, standardized Y",
      "full-X intercept before Age/HEI correction, standardized Y",
      "alpha0 functional contribution, original Y scale"
    ),
    
    mean = c(
      mean(intercept_gamma_std),
      mean(alpha0_func_contrib_std),
      mean(intercept_fullX_std),
      mean(alpha0_func_contrib_Yscale)
    ),
    
    sd = c(
      sd(intercept_gamma_std),
      sd(alpha0_func_contrib_std),
      sd(intercept_fullX_std),
      sd(alpha0_func_contrib_Yscale)
    )
  )
  
  
  ## ============================================================
  ## 14. Return
  ## ============================================================
  
  list(
    
    mapping = mapping,
    
    table = tab,
    
    draws = coef_orig,
    
    ## Standardization information
    Y_mean = y_mean,
    Y_sd = y_sd,
    Z_mean = z_mean,
    Z_sd = z_sd,
    
    ## Functional alpha_0 contribution
    alpha0_func_contrib_std =
      alpha0_func_contrib_std,
    
    alpha0_func_contrib_Yscale =
      alpha0_func_contrib_Yscale,
    
    ## Different intercept parameterizations
    intercept_gamma_std =
      intercept_gamma_std,
    
    intercept_fullX_std =
      intercept_fullX_std,
    
    intercept_original =
      intercept_orig,
    
    intercept_diagnostics =
      intercept_diagnostics
  )
}
```

## --LOO
```{r}
compare_y_loo <- function(fits, Y, y_scale = stats::sd(Y),
                          cores = 2, save_psis = TRUE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("loo", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install the loo package.")
  }
  if (!is.list(fits)) stop("fits must be a named list.")
  fits <- fits[!vapply(fits, is.null, logical(1))]
  nm <- names(fits)
  if (length(fits) < 2L || is.null(nm) || anyNA(nm) ||
      any(nm == "") || anyDuplicated(nm)) {
    stop("Provide at least two fits with distinct, nonempty names.")
  }
  if (!is.numeric(Y) || length(Y) < 2L || any(!is.finite(Y))) {
    stop("Y must contain the finite outcomes actually used in all fits.")
  }
  if (!is.numeric(y_scale) || !length(y_scale) ||
      any(!is.finite(y_scale)) || any(y_scale <= 0)) {
    stop("y_scale must contain positive finite scale values.")
  }
  if (length(y_scale) == 1L) {
    y_scale <- stats::setNames(rep(y_scale, length(fits)), nm)
  } else {
    if (is.null(names(y_scale)) || anyDuplicated(names(y_scale)) ||
        !all(nm %in% names(y_scale))) {
      stop("For different scales, name y_scale values to match the fits.")
    }
    y_scale <- y_scale[nm]
  }

  loo_list <- stats::setNames(lapply(nm, function(model) {
    cat("\n---", model, ": PSIS-LOO ---\n")

    # Post-warmup iterations x chains x participants
    ll_y <- loo::extract_log_lik(
      fits[[model]], parameter_name = "log_lik_y", merge_chains = FALSE
    )
    if (length(dim(ll_y)) != 3L || dim(ll_y)[3L] != length(Y)) {
      stop(model, ": log_lik_y must have dimensions iterations x chains x N,",
           " with N = length(Y).")
    }
    if (any(!is.finite(ll_y))) {
      stop(model, ": log_lik_y contains NA, NaN or infinite values.")
    }

    # Apply the Jacobian ONCE, to this freshly extracted local array.
    ll_y <- ll_y - log(y_scale[[model]])

    # Stabilize exp() for r_eff only. The array preserves chain information.
    ll_centered <- sweep(ll_y, 3L, apply(ll_y, 3L, max), FUN = "-")
    r_eff <- loo::relative_eff(exp(ll_centered), cores = cores)

    # Use the uncentered, original-Y-scale log density for LOO.
    ans <- loo::loo(ll_y, r_eff = r_eff, cores = cores,
                    save_psis = save_psis)
    print(ans)
    ans
  }), nm)

  bad_k <- lapply(loo_list, loo::pareto_k_ids)
  if (any(lengths(bad_k) > 0L)) {
    warning("High Pareto k detected: inspect bad_k and resolve unreliable ",
            "LOO estimates before interpreting the ranking.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  comparison <- loo::loo_compare(loo_list)
  cat("\n--- Model comparison: outcome-only ELPD ---\n")
  print(comparison, simplify = FALSE)

  invisible(list(loo = loo_list, comparison = comparison,
                 bad_k = bad_k, y_scale = y_scale))
}
```
